name: bg-silk
title: Silk Background
blurb: Animated shader renders flowing silk-like fabric pattern with wave distortion.
description: ShaderToy-based background using GLSL shader for procedural fabric pattern. Supports hue, saturation, brightness, and speed adjustments for real-time customization.
use_when: Elegant background texture with motion, premium feel desired.
avoid_when: Browsers with WebGL disabled, or contexts where shader compilation adds latency.
a11y: Purely decorative animation; no interactive elements.
